00.name: Stop
00.behavior: stops or yields the current Field script.

03.name: OpenDialogueMode2
03.behavior: opens the selected dialogue block through the common creation path in fixed-size mode 2 using the trailing control byte.

05.name: CallRelative3
05.behavior: pushes IP+3 and calls a relative script routine.

06.name: CallRelative5
06.behavior: pushes IP+5 and calls a relative script routine.

07.name: StartActorScript
07.behavior: starts a target actor script without waiting.

08.name: StartActorScriptAndWait
08.behavior: starts and waits for actor script completion.

0A.name: CallTriggerZone2D
0A.behavior: conditionally calls the encoded target when the physically controlled actor lies inside the indexed trigger's inclusive XZ quadrilateral, otherwise advances four bytes.

0B.name: InitializeNpcActor
0B.behavior: initializes the current NPC from a selected field graphic, synchronizes placement, enables updates and visibility, and advances three bytes.

0C.name: UpdatePlayerCharacterPreserveIP
0C.behavior: runs the player-control update and restores the caller's VM instruction pointer afterward.

0D.name: Return
0D.behavior: pops the Field script call stack.

0E.name: Opcode0EAdvance
0E.behavior: advances one byte without changing other state.

0F.name: Opcode0FAdvance
0F.behavior: advances one byte without changing other state.

12.name: StartCustomFieldTransition
12.behavior: waits for coordinator readiness, stages the destination field and entry parameter, records the transition mode and fade length, and yields for in-place map replacement.

16.name: InitializePlayableActor
16.behavior: initializes a playable-character actor, updates player and party mappings, selects party or replacement graphics, applies entry placement, and handles missing-party fallback.

17.name: SetupMovementBoundingZone
17.behavior: allocates and loads four movement-boundary vertices.

19.name: SetCoordinatesAndClearMovementState
19.behavior: applies coordinates and clears movement state.

1A.name: SetWalkmeshAtCurrentPosition
1A.behavior: changes walkmesh at the actor's current position.

1B.name: SetWalkmeshAndCoordinates
1B.behavior: assigns walkmesh and evaluated actor coordinates.

1E.name: ResetActorElevationTracking
1E.behavior: clears the actor elevation offset, anchors elevation to the current Y position, and enables elevation updates.

1F.name: SetActorLowFlagsFromPackedByte
1F.behavior: replaces low actor flags from a packed byte.

20.name: SetCurrentActorFlags
20.behavior: decodes a script mask into current-actor flags.

21.name: SetActorMovementSpeed
21.behavior: writes the evaluated speed to ActorData+0x76, propagates it to the actor's bound field entity, and advances three bytecode bytes.

26.name: Sleep
26.behavior: initializes the current slot's byte timer from the evaluated operand, yields on every dispatch, and advances after N+1 scheduler selections for timer value N.

27.name: StopAndDisableActorVM
27.behavior: stops movement and disables actor VM state.

29.name: DisableAndHideActorVM
29.behavior: disables, hides, and closes actor dialogue.

31.name: CheckCurrentInputMask
31.behavior: advances five bytes when the evaluated mask intersects currently held controller input, otherwise branches to the encoded destination.

32.name: CheckAccumulatedInputMask
32.behavior: advances five bytes when the evaluated mask intersects accumulated controller input, otherwise branches to the encoded destination.

33.name: ResetAccumulatedInput
33.behavior: clears the accumulated controller-input mask and advances one byte.

34.name: WriteInventoryObjectQuantity
34.behavior: writes the encoded object's quantity to the requested script variable, using zero when the object is absent, and advances five bytes.

3A.name: VariableSetBit
3A.behavior: evaluates a zero-based bit index, masks it to five bits, and sets that bit in the selected script variable.

3B.name: VariableUnsetBit
3B.behavior: evaluates a zero-based bit index, masks it to five bits, and clears that bit in the selected script variable.

44.name: MoveActorAlongAngleWithStepLimit
44.behavior: continues planar walking along a scripted angle until the step limit expires or the generated target is reached.

45.name: MoveActorAlongAngle3DWithStepLimit
45.behavior: continues three-axis walking toward a point 32 units along a scripted angle with a vertical offset until the destination or step limit is reached.

46.name: StartYawDirectedMovement
46.behavior: derives current-actor X and Z movement components from the field entity's Y rotation, marks scripted movement active, and advances one byte.

47.name: WalkPlayerAndChangeField
47.behavior: waits for transition systems, enables scripted player control, and walks the player toward the current actor's offset exit point while committing the pending field transition.

48.name: WriteScriptU8ToVariable
48.behavior: writes a script byte to a variable.

49.name: WriteScriptS16ToVariable
49.behavior: writes a script halfword to a variable.

4A.name: MoveActorToPositionUnlimited
4A.behavior: starts planar movement toward evaluated absolute coordinates with no step limit and waits for arrival.

4B.name: MoveActorToPositionWithStepLimit
4B.behavior: continues planar walking toward scripted absolute coordinates until the destination or step limit is reached.

4C.name: MoveActorToPosition3D
4C.behavior: continues three-axis walking toward scripted absolute coordinates until the destination is reached.

4D.name: MoveActorToPosition3DWithStepLimit
4D.behavior: continues three-axis walking toward scripted absolute coordinates until the destination or step limit is reached.

4E.name: MoveActorByOffset
4E.behavior: continues planar walking toward coordinates relative to the starting position until the destination is reached.

4F.name: MoveActorByOffsetWithStepLimit
4F.behavior: continues planar walking toward coordinates relative to the starting position until the destination or step limit is reached.

50.name: MoveActorByOffset3D
50.behavior: continues three-axis walking toward a position relative to the starting coordinates until the destination is reached.

51.name: MoveActorByOffset3DWithStepLimit
51.behavior: continues three-axis walking toward a position relative to the starting coordinates until the destination or scripted step limit is reached.

52.name: FollowActor
52.behavior: continues planar walking toward a selected actor until contact range is reached.

53.name: FollowActorWithStepLimit
53.behavior: continues planar walking toward a selected actor until contact range or the scripted step limit is reached.

54.name: MoveTowardActorUnlimited
54.behavior: copies a selected actor's position into the movement target, uses an unlimited step count, moves toward the target, and advances five bytes upon completion.

55.name: MoveTowardActorWithStepLimit
55.behavior: copies a selected actor's position into the movement target, initializes the current slot's step limit, moves toward the target, and advances seven bytes upon completion.

56.name: StartWorldMapTransition
56.behavior: waits for loading and audio readiness, persists current Field state, disables encounters, stores the return field, initial position, camera yaw, and World Map mode, requests the World Map handoff, and advances ten bytes.

57.name: ContinueBallisticActorMove
57.behavior: initializes or continues a timed parabolic move to scripted coordinates, optionally derives elevation from the walkmesh, updates facing and position each frame, and supports walkmesh-only refresh mode.

5A.name: ResetActorMovementState
5A.behavior: clears current movement state, marks movement inactive, yields, and advances one byte.

5B.name: ParkActorMovementUpdate
5B.behavior: clears movement vectors and render offsets, marks movement and rotation inactive, and yields without advancing, so repeated selection parks the invocation on this opcode without releasing its slot.

5C.name: InitializePartySlotActor
5C.behavior: binds the current actor to a selected party slot, restores its saved map placement when applicable, initializes its sprite, and hides unavailable or off-map members.

5D.name: PlayAnimationAndClearCompletion
5D.behavior: starts the immediate actor animation and clears its completion latch.

5E.name: WaitForAnimationCompletion
5E.behavior: stalls until the actor animation completion latch is set, then removes the forced animation and advances.

5F.name: SetImmediateActorCardinalDirection
5F.behavior: rotates the current actor to the immediate world-relative cardinal direction.

68.name: SetTargetActorCameraRelativeDirection
68.behavior: rotates a selected actor to a scripted cardinal direction relative to the camera.

6A.name: SetCameraRelativeActorDirection
6A.behavior: maps a direction to camera-relative actor rotation.

6F.name: FaceActor
6F.behavior: turns the current actor toward the selected actor when that actor is valid.

70.name: FacePartyMember
70.behavior: turns the current actor toward the mapped party member when that member is present.

71.name: StartBattle
71.behavior: waits for coordinator readiness, stores the requested battle configuration, marks the battle handoff pending, yields, and advances three bytes.

72.name: PlayMusicModeZero
72.behavior: waits for music authorization then selects request mode zero and processes the requested music ID.

73.name: InitializeParticleSystemCommand
73.behavior: skips the disabled subcommand or initializes default particle banks and global particle parameters from three script arguments.

74.name: PlaySoundEffect
74.behavior: starts or stops the requested sound effect on channel 3 and advances three bytes.

75.name: PlayMusicModeMinusOne
75.behavior: waits for music authorization then selects request mode minus one and processes the requested music ID.

78.name: WaitForArchiveFile
78.behavior: requests or waits for the selected archive file.

7E.name: IncreasePartyHp
7E.behavior: increases HP for each valid party member selected by the script mask, caps each result at maximum HP, and advances four bytes.

7F.name: SetWalkmeshMaterialMotionAngleOffset
7F.behavior: sets the global angular offset added to the current walkmesh material's motion direction before its XZ vector is accumulated.

80.name: SetWalkmeshMaterialByte
80.behavior: writes a resolved value to the selected byte lane of a walkmesh material flag and advances five bytes.

81.name: OrWalkmeshMaterialByte
81.behavior: applies a bitwise OR with a resolved mask to the selected byte lane of a walkmesh material flag and advances five bytes.

82.name: WriteWalkmeshNormalByte
82.behavior: reads a selected byte from a packed walkmesh-normal entry, writes it to the requested script variable, and advances five bytes.

83.name: AndWalkmeshMaterialByte
83.behavior: applies a bitwise AND with a resolved mask to the selected byte lane of a walkmesh material flag and advances five bytes.

8B.name: CheckInventoryObject
8B.behavior: advances five bytes when the encoded object is present, otherwise branches to the encoded destination.

8C.name: AddInventoryObject
8C.behavior: adds one unit of the encoded object and advances three bytes.

8D.name: RemoveInventoryObject
8D.behavior: decrements an encoded object's quantity, clears its identifier when the quantity reaches zero, and advances three bytes.

93.name: AddCurrentActorToMechaList
93.behavior: initializes the current actor's base graphic, synchronizes its transform, assigns a mecha-list slot and model identifier, and increments the mecha count.

94.name: SetAndPauseEventTimer
94.behavior: packs two evaluated bytes into VM variable 0x0A, pauses the event timer, and resets its update divider.

95.name: ConfigureEventTimer
95.behavior: configures event-timer pause and count direction from the supplied control byte.

96.name: PauseAndResetEventTimerDivider
96.behavior: pauses the event timer and resets its update divider.

97.name: SetAutomaticCameraRotationSectorMask
97.behavior: sets the eight-sector mask that can trigger automatic camera orbit correction.

98.name: ChangeFieldWhenReady
98.behavior: waits for coordinator readiness, optionally saves the current field and directions, stages the destination field and entry parameter, marks replacement pending, then yields and advances five bytes.

99.name: EnterScriptCameraMode
99.behavior: enters script-controlled camera mode, snapshots yaw, dip, and scaled depth, resets scale, initializes target and eye smoothing to twelve, and locks manual orbit.

9A.name: LeaveOrReacquireFollowCamera
9A.behavior: in script mode, zero duration returns immediately to normal follow and advances six bytes, while nonzero duration starts asynchronous mode-2 reacquisition and advances three; an invocation already in mode 2 leaves the PC unchanged.

9B.name: SetCameraSmoothingDivisors
9B.behavior: sets independent target and eye smoothing divisors, normalizing either zero operand to one.

9C.name: WaitForOwnedTextBox
9C.behavior: waits for the actor's owned text box, conditionally requests its closure, and copies the confirmed choice line to VM variable 0x14 after the slot is released.

9D.name: InterpolateSceneScale
9D.behavior: starts interpolation from the current scene scale to the scripted scale over the encoded duration.

9E.name: SnapshotCameraGeometry
9E.behavior: waits for camera rotation to finish, then saves the current camera direction, projection distance, and depth-cue parameter and advances one byte.

9F.name: RestoreCameraGeometry
9F.behavior: waits for camera rotation to finish, then interpolates camera direction, projection distance, and depth-cue parameter back to their saved values over 32 frames.

A0.name: SetScreenGeometry
A0.behavior: sets depth cue, camera direction, and projection distance from three script operands, updates the geometry screen distance, and advances seven bytes.

A1.name: SetBlockedCameraSectorMask
A1.behavior: sets the eight-sector mask used to reject or redirect manual camera orbit.

A2.name: WaitForCameraAnimationMask
A2.behavior: advances only after every camera animation flag selected by the immediate mask has cleared.

A4.name: InterpolateCameraDip
A4.behavior: starts interpolation from the current camera dip to the scripted dip over the encoded duration.

A6.name: SkipScriptTriplets
A6.behavior: advances by three plus three times the evaluated signed count.

A7.name: UpdatePlayerCharacter
A7.behavior: processes player movement eligibility, idle detection, directional input, movement triggers, and facing before advancing one byte.

A9.name: SetupMultichoice
A9.behavior: waits for the current dialogue to accept choices, configures the packed first and last choice indices, initializes cursor state, and advances two bytes.

AA.name: SetImmediateCameraRelativeActorDirection
AA.behavior: rotates the current actor to an immediate cardinal direction relative to the camera.

AF.name: ReadOrWriteCameraYaw
AF.behavior: writes the captured camera yaw to a variable when the control byte is zero or replaces it from the operand otherwise, then advances four bytes.

B0.name: ReadOrWriteCameraDip
B0.behavior: writes the captured projection dip to a variable when the control byte is zero or replaces it from the operand otherwise, then advances four bytes.

B1.name: ReadOrWriteCameraDepth
B1.behavior: writes the captured scaled projection depth to a variable when the control byte is zero or replaces it with the unsigned operand otherwise, then advances four bytes.

B2.name: YieldUntilCameraAnimationMaskClears
B2.behavior: yields script execution while any camera animation flag selected by the immediate mask remains set.

B5.name: SetCameraDirectionTimed
B5.behavior: snaps the camera direction when interpolation is disabled, otherwise waits for an active rotation or starts a timed direction change, then advances five bytes and yields.

B6.name: InterpolateProjectionDepth
B6.behavior: applies or interpolates projection depth to the scripted value over the scripted duration.

B7.name: DisableCameraHeightCheck
B7.behavior: disables automatic camera height checking and advances the script.

B8.name: EnableCameraHeightCheck
B8.behavior: enables automatic camera height checking and advances the script.

B9.name: CheckAvailablePartyMember
B9.behavior: advances four bytes when the requested character is available, otherwise branches to the encoded destination.

BA.name: AddAvailablePartyMember
BA.behavior: sets the requested character's availability bit and advances two bytes.

BB.name: RemoveAvailablePartyMember
BB.behavior: clears the requested character's availability bit and advances two bytes.

BC.name: InitializeActorSprite
BC.behavior: creates and initializes actor sprite state.

C3.name: YieldCurrentCycle
C3.behavior: requests a VM yield and advances one byte.

C4.name: RotateActorAndSetStateFlag
C4.behavior: rotates an actor over 30 steps and sets its state flag.

C5.name: RotateActorAndClearStateFlag
C5.behavior: applies the inverse rotation and clears its state flag.

C6.name: Yield32
C6.behavior: adds 32 instructions to the VM budget and yields.

C7.name: StartCameraDollyMode0
C7.behavior: starts a positive one-eighth-turn camera dolly rotation over the requested duration when no rotation is active, then advances three bytes and yields.

C8.name: StartCameraDollyMode0Alias
C8.behavior: starts a positive one-eighth-turn camera dolly rotation over the requested duration when no rotation is active, then advances three bytes and yields.

C9.name: BranchUnlessInsideTriggerZone2D
C9.behavior: advances four bytes when the physically controlled actor lies inside the indexed trigger's inclusive XZ quadrilateral, otherwise branches to the encoded target.

CB.name: BranchUnlessInsideTriggerZone3D
CB.behavior: advances four bytes when the physically controlled actor straddles the indexed trigger's Y plane and lies inside its inclusive XZ quadrilateral, otherwise branches to the encoded target.

CC.name: CallTriggerZone3D
CC.behavior: conditionally calls the encoded target when the physically controlled actor straddles the indexed trigger's Y plane and lies inside its inclusive XZ quadrilateral, otherwise advances four bytes.

CD.name: DisableAutomaticContactScript
CD.behavior: suppresses automatic contact routine 3 while leaving explicit interaction routine 2 available.

CF.name: SetDialogueWindowImmediate
CF.behavior: stores immediate forced X and Y positions, width in three-pixel character units, and height, then advances five bytes.

D0.name: SetDialogueWindowEvaluated
D0.behavior: evaluates and stores forced X and Y positions, width in three-pixel character units, height, and window flags, then advances eleven bytes.

D1.name: ImmediateNoop
D1.behavior: returns immediately without changing script or field state.

D2.name: OpenActorDialogueMode0
D2.behavior: opens the selected dialogue block in actor-anchored mode 0 using the trailing control byte.

D3.name: OpenDialogueMode1
D3.behavior: opens the selected dialogue block in window mode 1 using the trailing control byte.

D4.name: OpenDialogueAtActorMode0
D4.behavior: resolves the selected actor as the placement anchor for the current actor's mode-zero dialogue, skips six bytes for an invalid actor, or rewinds one byte to retry deferred creation.

D6.name: SetDialogAnimationSpeed
D6.behavior: stores the dialog animation mode and selects eight, six, or four opening frames for modes zero, one, or two before advancing three bytes.

D7.name: SetObjectSwivelXAxis
D7.behavior: selects object swivel around X and stores the evaluated angle.

D8.name: SetObjectSwivelYAxis
D8.behavior: selects object swivel around Y and stores the evaluated angle.

D9.name: SetObjectSwivelZAxis
D9.behavior: selects object swivel around Z and stores the evaluated angle.

DA.name: CreateLineScrollEffect
DA.behavior: allocates and fills a line-scroll byte buffer, allocates and initializes its descriptor from six geometry parameters, registers up to 32 effects, and advances seventeen bytes.

DB.name: SetDeformationStrength
DB.behavior: caps a deformation strength at 0xFFF, stores it in the selected deformation slot when the current model supports deformation, and advances five bytes.

DC.name: SwapVariables
DC.behavior: exchanges the values of two script variables and advances five bytes.

DD.name: SetCurrentActorBlendParameters
DD.behavior: replaces rendering blend bits 5 through 6 from the low two operand bits, stores the accompanying rendering value, and advances six bytes.

E0.name: SetSelectedActorBlendParameters
E0.behavior: resolves an actor and, when valid, replaces its rendering blend bits and accompanying rendering value before advancing seven bytes.

E1.name: MoveOrClearVramRectangle
E1.behavior: clears the rectangle defined by the final four operands when the first coordinate pair is zero, otherwise moves the rectangle defined by the first four operands to the final coordinate pair, then advances fourteen bytes.

E2.name: CheckCurrentInputExact
E2.behavior: conditionally branches on exact current input.

E3.name: CheckAccumulatedInputExact
E3.behavior: conditionally branches on exact accumulated input.

E4.name: OpcodeE4NoOp
E4.behavior: returns immediately without changing state or advancing script execution.

E5.name: ConfigureFog
E5.behavior: stores near and far RGB colors plus near and far fog distances, enables fog, applies the new configuration, and advances seventeen bytes.

E6.name: SetCameraLimits
E6.behavior: stores the signed camera-limit origin and extents while negating the final extent and advances nine bytes.

E7.name: SetExtendedBackgroundClearColor
E7.behavior: stores the red, green, and blue background clear components and advances seven bytes.

E8.name: MoveActorAndSetStateFlag
E8.behavior: moves an actor for a scripted step count and sets its state flag.

E9.name: MoveActorAndClearStateFlag
E9.behavior: applies complementary movement and clears its state flag.

EA.name: WalkPlayerToAlignedExit
EA.behavior: waits for transition systems, enables scripted player control, and walks the player toward the current actor's aligned exit point while committing any pending field transition.

EB.name: ComputeOrbitPointFromCoordinates
EB.behavior: builds a camera-scale-adjusted orbit point around explicit coordinates from yaw, pitch, and magnitude inputs, writes its X, Z, and Y coordinates, and advances twenty bytes.

F0.name: WriteCameraProjectionParameters
F0.behavior: writes captured camera yaw, projection dip, and scaled projection depth to three variables and advances seven bytes.

F1.name: SetupRgbCalculationMode1
F1.behavior: configures RGB calculation mode 1 from five script parameters.

F2.name: SetupCameraShake
F2.behavior: configures target X, Z, and Y shake offsets and per-frame deltas for a nonzero duration, with an extended return-to-zero phase when every target is zero.

F4.name: CloseDialogueOrResetWindowConfig
F4.behavior: control value zero requests closure of the actor's owned dialogue, while a nonzero value clears configured width, height, forced position, and window flags.

F5.name: OpenCenteredDialogueMode3
F5.behavior: opens the selected dialogue block in centered mode 3 using the trailing control byte.

F6.name: ConfigureActorRotationLockMode
F6.behavior: clears rotation locking and residual motion for mode zero, locks and snapshots rotation for mode one, enables deferred motion cleanup for mode two, and advances two bytes.

F7.name: ConfigureRandomEncounterTimers
F7.behavior: evaluates the encounter timer range and active-timer count, caps the count at 32, and regenerates that many unique randomized countdowns.

F8.name: UpdateCurrentActorFlagQuarter
F8.behavior: sets or clears the selected lower or upper 16-bit quarter of either current actor flag group and advances four bytes.

FA.name: AdjustActorAxisRotation
FA.behavior: adjusts a selected actor rotation axis.

FB.name: JumpIfIndexedBitClear
FB.behavior: conditionally branches on an indexed bit.

FC.name: OpenDialogueAtActorWithCopiedPortrait
FC.behavior: resolves the selected actor, copies its portrait ID into the current actor, and opens the current actor's mode-zero dialogue anchored to the selected actor; an invalid selector skips six bytes and deferred creation retries.

FE.name: ExtendedDispatch
FE.behavior: executes the secondary Field script VM.

00.name: ExtendedOpcodeZeroNoOp
00.behavior: returns immediately without changing runtime state.

03.name: SetCurrentActorUniformScale
03.behavior: sets uniform actor scale, applies a three-quarter sprite scale, refreshes rotation, and advances three bytes.

04.name: SetCurrentActorSpriteGeometryScale
04.behavior: doubles the supplied value into the current actor's sprite geometry scale and advances three bytes.

05.name: CheckActorWalkmeshId
05.behavior: advances six bytes when the selected actor uses the requested walkmesh, otherwise branches to the encoded destination.

06.name: CheckActorWalkmeshMaterial
06.behavior: advances six bytes when the selected actor's current triangle has the requested material byte, otherwise branches to the encoded destination.

07.name: SetCurrentActorFlag400FromMode
07.behavior: clears actor flag 0x400 for mode zero, sets it for mode one, and advances two bytes.

08.name: SetCurrentActorAxisScales
08.behavior: sets independent actor X, Y, and Z scales, restores the sprite scale to 0xC00, refreshes rotation, and advances seven bytes.

09.name: ToggleActorMechaSuppression
09.behavior: clears actor flag 0x800 for a zero operand and sets it otherwise, controlling mecha and shadow suppression.

0C.name: SetSharedGeometryParameters
0C.behavior: sets six signed shared geometry parameters from script operands.

0D.name: SetDialogPortraitCharacter
0D.behavior: resolves a character selector and stores it as the current actor's dialog portrait identifier.

0E.name: FadeMusicVolume
0E.behavior: transitions music volume to the requested target over the requested duration and retries when music startup is incomplete.

0F.name: FadeMusicPitch
0F.behavior: transitions music pitch to a signed target over the requested duration and retries when music startup is incomplete.

10.name: FadeMusicTempo
10.behavior: transitions music tempo to the requested target over the requested duration and retries when music startup is incomplete.

11.name: FadeMusicPan
11.behavior: transitions music pan to a signed target over the requested duration and retries when music startup is incomplete.

12.name: SetMusicChannelMask
12.behavior: applies a channel-enable mask to the active music instance and updates affected voices.

13.name: ConfigureActorPositionalSound
13.behavior: assigns the current actor's positional sound identifier and volume in mode 0, stops its previous channel, and marks zero identifiers inactive.

14.name: ConfigureActorPositionalSoundMode80
14.behavior: assigns the current actor's positional sound identifier and volume with mode 0x80, stops its previous channel, and marks zero identifiers inactive.

15.name: InitializeActorGraphicVariant
15.behavior: initializes the current actor from a selected field graphic and variant, synchronizes placement, enables updates and visibility, and advances five bytes.

16.name: FreeMovementBoundingZone
16.behavior: releases the current actor's allocated movement-boundary vertices and clears their ownership flag.

17.name: FaceActorTowardActor
17.behavior: turns the first selected actor toward the second selected actor when both are valid.

18.name: AddImmediatePartyCharacter
18.behavior: reserves a staging slot and begins loading an immediate party character, or marks an already staged character as present.

19.name: RemovePartyCharacter
19.behavior: removes a resolved party member, compacts party resources and slot metadata, and reactivates shifted actors.

1A.name: FinalizePartyCharacterLoad
1A.behavior: waits for staged loading, decompresses the character resource, releases compressed data, and initializes the first entry actor targeting that character.

1B.name: AdjustCurrentModelRedGreen
1B.behavior: adds signed red and green deltas to every current-model vertex and mirrors the colors into the alternate render buffer.

1C.name: SetActorPosition3DImmediate
1C.behavior: places the current actor at scripted XYZ coordinates and synchronizes its rendered and physical positions.

1D.name: SetGlobalModelTranslationStep
1D.behavior: sets the global XYZ model translation increments and enables their application.

1E.name: SwitchMapToGears
1E.behavior: synchronizes assets and marks the Field map for Gear mode.

1F.name: MountCurrentPartyActor
1F.behavior: maps the current actor to a party slot, mounts it when not already riding a gear, and advances one byte.

20.name: DismountPartyCharacter
20.behavior: resolves the selected character to a party slot, dismounts it when currently riding a gear, and advances two bytes.

21.name: InitializePartyCharacterActor
21.behavior: resolves a character into the active party, binds its party graphics and synchronized transform, or creates a disabled placeholder when absent.

22.name: WriteProjectionDepth
22.behavior: writes the current projection depth to script memory.

23.name: MovePartyToFormation
23.behavior: moves the three party slots toward separate scripted positions and facings until all arrive, while the sentinel mode immediately normalizes their rotations.

24.name: GatherPartyAtLeader
24.behavior: moves all three party slots to the leader, stalls until every valid member arrives, then resets follow history.

25.name: SetCameraFollowHeightMode
25.behavior: loads the camera follow-height mode from the next byte and advances two bytes.

26.name: SetupScreenDistortion
26.behavior: initializes screen distortion mode 0 from seven script parameters.

27.name: ControlScreenDistortion
27.behavior: starts distortion fade-out, waits for completion, stops updates, or releases distortion resources according to its subcommand.

28.name: WriteCurrentActorFlags1
28.behavior: writes current actor flag word 1 to the indexed script variable and advances three bytes.

29.name: WriteCurrentActorFlags2
29.behavior: writes current actor flag word 2 to the indexed script variable and advances three bytes.

2A.name: WriteCurrentActorFlags3
2A.behavior: writes current actor flag word 3 to the indexed script variable and advances three bytes.

2B.name: WriteCurrentActorFlags4
2B.behavior: writes current actor flag word 4 to the indexed script variable and advances three bytes.

30.name: JumpUnlessCurrentActorFlags1Set
30.behavior: branches to the encoded destination when the requested mask does not intersect current actor flag word 1, otherwise advances five bytes.

31.name: JumpUnlessCurrentActorFlags2Set
31.behavior: branches to the encoded destination when the requested mask does not intersect current actor flag word 2, otherwise advances five bytes.

32.name: JumpUnlessCurrentActorFlags3Set
32.behavior: branches to the encoded destination when the requested mask does not intersect current actor flag word 3, otherwise advances five bytes.

33.name: JumpUnlessCurrentActorFlags4Set
33.behavior: branches to the encoded destination when the requested mask does not intersect current actor flag word 4, otherwise advances five bytes.

34.name: JumpUnlessTargetActorFlags1Set
34.behavior: branches to the encoded destination when the requested mask does not intersect target actor flag word 1, otherwise advances six bytes.

35.name: JumpUnlessTargetActorFlags2Set
35.behavior: branches to the encoded destination when the requested mask does not intersect target actor flag word 2, otherwise advances six bytes.

36.name: JumpUnlessTargetActorFlags3Set
36.behavior: branches to the encoded destination when the requested mask does not intersect target actor flag word 3, otherwise advances six bytes.

37.name: JumpUnlessTargetActorFlags4Set
37.behavior: branches to the encoded destination when the requested mask does not intersect target actor flag word 4, otherwise advances six bytes.

38.name: WriteActorDistance
38.behavior: resolves two actor selectors, computes their planar distance from fixed-point X/Z positions, writes zero if either actor is absent, and stores the result in the selected script variable.

39.name: SetActorAnimationOffsetScale
39.behavior: sets the global multiplier used to convert animation displacement samples into planar actor offsets and advances three bytes.

3A.name: SetPartyFrameMask
3A.behavior: resolves a character selector and sets that character's bit in the party frame mask.

3B.name: ClearPartyFrameMask
3B.behavior: resolves a character selector and clears that character's bit in the party frame mask.

3C.name: PlayMechaAnimation
3C.behavior: starts the selected animation on a mecha slot and records its current animation identifier.

3D.name: SetPrimaryMechaMatrixRow
3D.behavior: writes three signed values into a selected row of the primary mecha field matrix.

3E.name: SetSecondaryMechaMatrixRow
3E.behavior: writes three signed values into a selected row of the secondary mecha field matrix.

3F.name: SetBackgroundClearColor
3F.behavior: sets the background clear red, green, and blue components.

40.name: WriteLineScrollByte
40.behavior: writes one byte at the requested offset of a line-scroll buffer when the offset is below its configured length and advances seven bytes.

41.name: PartyMemberRideGear
41.behavior: mounts a party member in Gear.

43.name: DisablePartyFollow
43.behavior: disables party members following the leader.

44.name: EnablePartyFollow
44.behavior: enables party following, clears follow state, and seeds the complete movement history with the leader's current state.

45.name: SetAnimationOverride
45.behavior: replaces the current actor animation override with the immediate animation identifier.

46.name: SetMechaRotationAuthority
46.behavior: selects whether the current actor follows its mecha root rotation or drives that rotation.

47.name: SetDefaultModelTurnRate
47.behavior: sets the default angular step used when rotating field models toward their targets.

48.name: SetCameraProjectionAngles
48.behavior: sets the three signed camera projection angles.

49.name: ClearCurrentActorParent
49.behavior: sets the current actor's parent identifier to 0xFF and advances one byte.

4A.name: BeginSpecialAnimationLoad
4A.behavior: replaces the current actor's special-animation allocation and begins loading the selected animation resource.

4B.name: FinalizeSpecialAnimationLoad
4B.behavior: waits for loading to finish, attaches the special animation to the current sprite, and retries while busy.

4C.name: SetForcedAnimationAndReleaseOverride
4C.behavior: sets the complemented forced-animation identifier and clears actor flag 0x10000.

4D.name: SetForcedAnimationComplement
4D.behavior: stores the bitwise complement of an immediate animation identifier as the current actor's forced animation.

4E.name: FreeSpecialAnimation
4E.behavior: releases the current actor's special-animation allocation and resets its resource identifier.

4F.name: EnableFieldMenu
4F.behavior: allows the player to open the normal Field menu.

50.name: DisableFieldMenu
50.behavior: prevents the player from opening the normal Field menu.

53.name: EnableEncountersFieldMenuAndCompass
53.behavior: enables random encounters, the player-opened Field menu, and the Field compass.

54.name: DisableEncountersFieldMenuAndCompass
54.behavior: disables random encounters, the player-opened Field menu, and the Field compass.

55.name: OpenNormalMenu
55.behavior: queues menu mode 0 with the configured menu argument, yields, increments the open-menu count, and advances one byte.

56.name: OpenMenuMode1WithSelection
56.behavior: copies the evaluated selection into script variable 1 and persistent menu state, queues menu mode 1, yields, and advances three bytes.

57.name: OpenLoadGameMenu
57.behavior: queues menu mode 2, yields, increments the open-menu count, and advances one byte.

58.name: OpenEnterNameMenu
58.behavior: queues the Enter Name menu for the selected character or name record and yields the current script.

59.name: OpenShopMenu
59.behavior: queues the selected shop inventory and yields the current script.

5A.name: OpenGearShopMenu
5A.behavior: queues the selected Gear shop inventory and yields the current script.

5B.name: SetActorModelTurnRate
5B.behavior: sets the current actor's model-specific angular rotation step.

5C.name: LoadCurrentActorMecha
5C.behavior: waits for I/O, hides or frees the indexed mecha, asynchronously loads replacement files, then constructs and binds the replacement with the actor's scale and position.

5D.name: PlaySoundEffectWithParameters
5D.behavior: plays the requested sound effect on channel 3 with resolved volume and pan values and advances seven bytes.

5E.name: SetCurrentActorTransparencyMode
5E.behavior: applies the selected transparency mode to the current actor and advances three bytes.

5F.name: SetCurrentActorDualLightingColors
5F.behavior: conditionally assigns either or both RGB lighting triplets to the current actor and advances eight bytes.

60.name: StartPreset2DPresentation
60.behavior: starts a 2D presentation using resource, offset, limit, and mode arguments with mode-specific viewport defaults, or rewinds until resources are available.

61.name: WaitFor2DPresentationReady
61.behavior: rewinds while presentation readiness is clear, otherwise clears readiness and advances one byte, yielding after every check.

62.name: SetSoundChannelVolume
62.behavior: immediately sets the selected sound channel volume and advances five bytes.

63.name: SetSoundChannelPan
63.behavior: immediately sets the selected sound channel pan and advances five bytes.

64.name: WaitForSoundChannelMaskClear
64.behavior: rewinds while any selected sound channel remains active, otherwise advances three bytes, yielding after every check.

65.name: PlayOrStopSoundEffectChannel
65.behavior: stops the selected channel when the effect identifier is zero, otherwise starts that effect with default volume and pan, then advances five bytes.

66.name: PlaySoundEffectChannelCustomized
66.behavior: restarts the selected channel with the supplied effect identifier, volume, and pan, then advances nine bytes.

67.name: StartExplicit2DPresentation
67.behavior: starts a 2D presentation with explicit resource, offsets, mode, dimensions, and scale values, then advances 19 bytes.

68.name: WalkPlayerToPositionAndWait
68.behavior: waits for transition systems to become ready, walks the player toward resolved X and Z coordinates, preserves the player's preexisting control flag, and completes after reaching or failing to reach the destination.

69.name: GetPartyProgressTotal
69.behavior: writes a selected character's base-plus-remainder progression to a script variable, or zero when no character resolves.

6A.name: SetLinkOrderingTableIndex
6A.behavior: sets the ordering-table link index from an immediate or variable operand.

6B.name: SetPartyProgressRemainder
6B.behavior: sets a selected character's progression remainder to the nonnegative difference between a requested total and its base progression.

6C.name: ClearControllerEnableFlag
6C.behavior: clears the controller enable byte when the operand is zero, then advances one byte.

6D.name: SnapshotCameraProjectionBaseline
6D.behavior: snapshots the current scaled projection depth, projection dip, and camera yaw as script baselines, resets camera scale to 0x1000, and advances one byte.

6F.name: SetGlobalModelRotation
6F.behavior: sets the three signed global model-rotation angles used to rebuild the rendering matrix.

70.name: SetBackgroundModelRenderMode
70.behavior: stores the script byte minus 0x80 as the mode controlling camera-offset application and forced rendering for background models, then advances three bytes.

71.name: WriteCurrentActorRotationAngle
71.behavior: writes the current actor rotation modulo one revolution to script memory.

72.name: WriteInterpolatedAngle
72.behavior: interpolates between two scripted angles by a scripted step and writes the resulting angle to script memory.

73.name: WriteDistanceBetween2DPoints
73.behavior: computes the planar distance between two scripted points and writes the result to script memory.

74.name: DebugPrintVariableHexAndDecimal
74.behavior: evaluates the encoded operand and prints it in hexadecimal and decimal when Field debug output is enabled.

75.name: WriteActorRotationAngle
75.behavior: writes a selected actor rotation modulo one revolution to script memory when that actor is valid.

76.name: WriteDistanceBetween3DPoints
76.behavior: computes the spatial distance between two scripted points and writes the result to script memory.

77.name: ManageOverlayImageAsset
77.behavior: waits for archive I/O, then loads an indexed image into memory, uploads it with optional VRAM backup, or releases it according to the mode, and stops the current VM cycle.

78.name: ReservedOpcode78NoOp
78.behavior: returns immediately without changing state as the reserved opcode 0x78 entry.

79.name: ReservedOpcode79NoOp
79.behavior: returns immediately without changing state as the reserved opcode 0x79 entry.

7A.name: ReservedOpcode7ANoOp
7A.behavior: returns immediately without changing state as the reserved opcode 0x7A entry.

7B.name: ReservedOpcode7BNoOp
7B.behavior: returns immediately without changing state as the reserved opcode 0x7B entry.

7C.name: ReservedOpcode7CNoOp
7C.behavior: returns immediately without changing state as the reserved opcode 0x7C entry.

7D.name: ReservedOpcode7DNoOp
7D.behavior: returns immediately without changing state as the reserved opcode 0x7D entry.

7E.name: ReservedOpcode7ENoOp
7E.behavior: returns immediately without changing state as the reserved opcode 0x7E entry.

7F.name: WaitForVideoPlayback
7F.behavior: yields and repeats while video playback remains active, advances when playback finishes, and stops the current VM cycle.

80.name: SetPanoramaGeometryParameters
80.behavior: stores eight panorama geometry and texture parameters, forces a zero third parameter to one, clears the fifth parameter, and advances fifteen bytes.

81.name: SetPanoramaOrientationVector
81.behavior: evaluates and stores the panorama orientation vector's X, Z, and Y components and advances eight bytes.

82.name: SetPanoramaColorParameters
82.behavior: stores three RGB triplets and three additional panorama values, enables panorama rendering, and advances twenty-five bytes.

83.name: SetBootModeWhenReady
83.behavior: when boot-mode changes are permitted, disables random encounters for the transition, clears the readiness gate, stores the requested boot mode, and advances three bytes.

84.name: StartBattleWithReturnField
84.behavior: waits for coordinator readiness, stores the requested battle and optional post-battle Field destination and variable 2 value, marks the battle handoff pending, yields, and advances nine bytes.

85.name: WriteVideoPlaybackFrame
85.behavior: writes the current video playback frame to a script variable and advances three bytes.

86.name: SetVideoTransitionMode
86.behavior: stores the raw video-transition mode byte and advances two bytes.

87.name: WaitForMenuClose
87.behavior: yields while a menu remains open by rewinding one byte, otherwise advances one byte.

88.name: ConfigureProximityLightGradient
88.behavior: stores indexed near and far RGB triplets plus the interpolation range used for distance-dependent model lighting, then advances eighteen bytes.

89.name: SetProximityLightAnchor
89.behavior: stores an indexed XYZ lighting anchor and its resolved actor association, using -1 when resolution fails, then advances eleven bytes.

8A.name: SetSpatialAudioListenerSource
8A.behavior: selects the controlled actor, camera eye, or camera target as the spatial-audio listener source and advances three bytes.

8B.name: WriteCurrentActorPartySlot
8B.behavior: writes the current actor's party slot from the three active mappings or 0xFF when absent, then advances three bytes.

8C.name: RampSoundChannelVolume
8C.behavior: ramps the selected sound channel toward a supplied volume over a supplied duration and advances seven bytes.

8D.name: SetSoundChannelPreserveMask
8D.behavior: sets the mask that exempts selected sound channels from the next field audio reset and advances three bytes.

8E.name: SetScreenBoundsPadding
8E.behavior: sets horizontal and vertical padding used by actor screen-bound checks and advances five bytes.

8F.name: ResetParticleConfigResolvedActor
8F.behavior: resolves an actor with zero fallback, stores three particle modifiers, resets its default particle banks, normalizes mode values 1 through 3 to 0x10 through 0x30, adds four VM cycles, and advances eight bytes.

98.name: SetSpatialAudioFalloffDistance
98.behavior: stores the evaluated maximum distance used for spatial-audio attenuation and advances three bytes.

99.name: SetMenuOpenArgument
99.behavior: stores the inverse of the supplied one-bit menu argument and advances two bytes.

9A.name: SetTargetActorDualLightingColors
9A.behavior: conditionally assigns either or both RGB lighting triplets to a resolved actor and advances nine bytes.

9B.name: StartTransitionEffectMode1
9B.behavior: selects transition effect mode 1 with the supplied effect parameter and advances three bytes.

9C.name: StartTransitionEffectMode2
9C.behavior: selects transition effect mode 2 with the supplied effect parameter and advances three bytes.

9D.name: StartTransitionEffectMode3
9D.behavior: selects transition effect mode 3 with the supplied effect parameter and advances three bytes.

9E.name: SetDrawClipRegion
9E.behavior: applies four supplied display clipping dimensions and advances nine bytes.

9F.name: SetPartyFrameLock
9F.behavior: resolves a character and sets or clears that character's party-frame-lock bit according to the mode byte, then advances four bytes.

A0.name: StartSigned2DPresentation
A0.behavior: starts a signed-parameter 2D presentation with fixed viewport defaults, or rewinds and yields until presentation resources are available.

A2.name: WaitForMusicLoad
A2.behavior: yields and repeats while music loading is pending, advances when loading finishes, and stops the current VM cycle.

A3.name: ToggleVramRegionBackup
A3.behavior: captures the fixed VRAM region when the mode is zero or restores and releases it otherwise, then advances two bytes.

A4.name: RestoreAllGearFuelAndEther
A4.behavior: restores fuel and ether to their maxima for all twenty Gears and advances one byte.

A5.name: SetParticleRotationAngle
A5.behavior: stores the active particle slot value, merges evaluated flags into its high byte, stores its rotation angle, adds four VM cycles, and advances seven bytes.

A6.name: ConfigureSingleKeySpriteMotion
A6.behavior: initializes current-actor sprite motion mode 2, stores one nibble selector and one packed 9-bit key value, marks the motion active, and advances five bytes.

A7.name: ConfigureDualKeySpriteMotion
A7.behavior: initializes current-actor sprite motion mode 3, stores two nibble selectors and two packed 9-bit key values, marks the motion active, and advances nine bytes.

AA.name: SetCameraTrackedActor
AA.behavior: resolves the encoded actor and stores it as the camera tracking subject, then advances two bytes.

AE.name: ConfigureSpecialMovementAnimation
AE.behavior: sets the special-movement enable value, animation identifier, and countdown reload, clears the active countdown, and advances seven bytes.

AF.name: TransformActorJointOffset
AF.behavior: resolves an actor joint transform, applies it to a script-supplied vector, writes the transformed XYZ coordinates to three script variables, and advances eighteen bytes.

B0.name: LoadWdsSoundBankSlot
B0.behavior: replaces a selected WDS sound-bank slot through asynchronous loading and finalizes the bank on re-entry.

B1.name: InitializeCameraDirectionGauge
B1.behavior: loads the direction-gauge texture, allocates double-buffered packets, initializes 109 textured quads, and advances one byte.

B5.name: IncrementPartyConvergenceOverride
B5.behavior: increments the party-convergence override counter and advances one byte.

B6.name: SetControlledAndTrackedActor
B6.behavior: resolves the requested actor, assigns it as both the physically controlled and camera-tracked actor, records whether control differs from the normal party leader, clears control flags from every actor, assigns control to the selected actor, and advances two bytes.

B7.name: SetInteractionAvailabilityOverride
B7.behavior: stores an evaluated interaction-availability override and advances three bytes.

B8.name: SetTransitionMusicId
B8.behavior: writes an evaluated music ID to the field-transition slot when the selector is zero or the battle-transition slot otherwise, then advances four bytes.

B9.name: WriteCompleteWorldMapPosition
B9.behavior: writes all four saved world-map position components to script variables and advances nine bytes.

BA.name: SetWorldMapPosition
BA.behavior: evaluates and stores all four saved world-map position components and advances ten bytes.

BB.name: WriteWorldMapVehicleState
BB.behavior: writes the saved world-map vehicle state to a script variable and advances three bytes.

BC.name: SetWorldMapVehicleState
BC.behavior: evaluates and stores the saved world-map vehicle state and advances four bytes.

BD.name: SetParticleAttachmentMode
BD.behavior: sets particle flag 0x80 for mode 1 or 0x40 for mode 2, adds four VM cycles, and advances seven bytes.

BE.name: EnableVideoFrameTileAnimation
BE.behavior: enables animated video-frame tile cycling and advances one byte.

BF.name: SetupBattling
BF.behavior: waits for field resources and music readiness, then stores six battle parameters and requests battle setup.

C0.name: WriteBattlingMatchResultCode
C0.behavior: copies the Battling mode match-result code to a script variable.

C1.name: QueryPartySpriteAnimationStatus
C1.behavior: resolves a party actor, writes its sprite-animation status and actor index to script variables, clears nonterminal status values, adds four VM cycles, and advances seven bytes.

C2.name: ResetParticleConfigImmediateActor
C2.behavior: selects an immediate actor with zero fallback, stores three particle modifiers, resets its default particle banks, normalizes mode values 1 through 3 to 0x10 through 0x30, adds four VM cycles, and advances nine bytes.

C3.name: SetCurrentActorFlags02000800
C3.behavior: sets flags 0x02000000 and 0x800 on the current actor.

C4.name: SetActorFlags02000800ById
C4.behavior: sets actor flags 0x02000000 and 0x800 by ID.

C6.name: QueueVariablePartyCharacterLoad
C6.behavior: resolves an immediate-or-variable character, reserves a staging slot, and begins loading when no duplicate or conflicting load exists.

C7.name: WriteActorCharacterGearId
C7.behavior: resolves an actor selector, writes its character's Gear ID or 0xFF to a script variable, and advances five bytes.

CA.name: ReleaseCurrentActorMecha
CA.behavior: clears the actor's active-mecha flag, then either hides its indexed mecha or frees it and decrements the loaded-mecha count before yielding.

CB.name: RequestDirectorModeExit
CB.behavior: increments the director-mode exit signal, advances one byte, and yields the current script.

CC.name: WaitForDirectorModeEnd
CC.behavior: advances when director-only mode is inactive, otherwise rewinds one byte and yields so the instruction is retried.

CD.name: WriteCurrentDiscNumber
CD.behavior: queries the current disc number, writes it to the selected script variable, and advances three bytes.

CE.name: SetMaxMechaCount
CE.behavior: sets the maximum mecha overlay entry count from a script operand and advances three bytes.

CF.name: OpenMenuMode1WithFieldContext
CF.behavior: disables field controls, saves field and direction state, installs the requested field and variable 2 value, queues menu mode 1, yields, and advances five bytes.

D0.name: CloneGearAndAbilityState
D0.behavior: copies one Gear's persistent state and associated ability blocks to another slot and marks special destination slots present.

D2.name: SkipThreeByteInstruction
D2.behavior: advances past a three-byte no-op instruction.

D3.name: ScaleTwoRatios
D3.behavior: scales two script ratios and writes both results.

D4.name: ManageSpriteOverlayList
D4.behavior: mode 0 allocates and initializes a 33-entry sprite-overlay list, mode 1 links an indexed entry at evaluated screen coordinates, mode 2 frees the list, and mode 3 sets an indexed entry's RGB color.

D5.name: WriteWorldMapPosition
D5.behavior: writes both persistent world-map position values to script variables.

D6.name: WriteGameState184EAnd1852
D6.behavior: writes two game-state fields to script memory.

D7.name: SetWorldMapMarkerPositionXZ
D7.behavior: writes evaluated X and Z coordinates into the saved world-map marker position, clears Y and padding, marks the position valid, and advances six bytes.

D8.name: SetSpriteLightingBypass
D8.behavior: stores a script byte that enables or bypasses dynamic sprite color lighting.

D9.name: SetRandomTurnDirectionTable
D9.behavior: stores a script byte selecting the direction table used for random actor turns.

DA.name: OpenMenuMode6
DA.behavior: queues menu mode 6 with argument 1, yields, increments the open-menu count, and advances one byte.

DC.name: SetPartySpriteColumnOffset
DC.behavior: writes an indexed byte controlling a party sprite's horizontal render column.

DD.name: VramSnapshotCommand
DD.behavior: allocates and captures a 256-pixel-wide VRAM region, applies indexed brightness conversion, or releases the working buffers according to subcommand.

DE.name: OrCharacterRecordFlags
DE.behavior: applies bitwise OR with a script-supplied mask to the selected character's persistent flag field.

E1.name: CopyGear
E1.behavior: copies Gear state from a Field script.

E2.name: SoftReset
E2.behavior: performs a software reset, requests script suspension, and advances the instruction pointer.
